notes:
Lead origin: self-serve signup/credit card trial (signup 2026-02-10). Key events and timeline:
- 2026-02-10: Signup, generated first API key, quickstart token used (dev reported latency ~120-160ms).
- 2026-02-12: Automated onboarding email + pricing doc shared (drive link).
- 2026-02-15: First dev test run — low volume (~300 tokens), two 200ms latency spikes, saw 429 when burst tested.
- 2026-02-18: 20-min call (ff-20260218-83b2e) w/ founder (M. Hale) + dev (J. Ramos). Notes: liked response quality and latency; "pricing looks high compared to what we saw elsewhere". Asked about per-route limits and pilot SLA.
- 2026-02-24: Follow-up email from AE (Ethan) offering configuration tips (streaming + smaller batch sizes). No uptake.

- 2026-03-09: SE debug session (Nina) identified default rate-limit settings on the account (conservative), and suggested enabling streaming and KV cache for follow-up POC.
Current sentiment: lukewarm. Engineering likes latency/behavior but business owner concerned about unit cost and ease of integration. Developer quote on 2026-02-18 call: "Output quality is great — but we already have an OpenAI integration in our stack, switching cost matters."
Use-case specifics / requirements summary:
- Primary workload: chat widget for product Q&A and reviews summarization; also using embeddings for short-term recommendation ranking.
- Target latency: <200ms p95 for short prompt flows, acceptable up to 500ms for longer summarization jobs.
- Throughput: initial pilot 50 req/min, target 300 req/min if succesful.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB with narrow margin, wants predictable per-message pricing and burst protections.
- Model preferences: open to Llama-variant or curated open models; prefers smaller quantized variants for cost.
- Routing / fallback: wants automatic fallback to cheaper model variant if cost per token spikes; also regional routing (NA).
- Compliance: needs basic SSO (SAML) and audit logs; data residency not strict for now.
Next steps proposed by AE/SE:
- Offer a 30-day $500 usage credit scoped to chat flows + guidance doc with starter settings (batching/streaming/KV).
- Quick 20-min dev walkthrough to flip streaming on and demo prompt templates for reduced token usage (owner: Nina).
- Send simple migration guide for their existing OpenAI calls -> Redwood hosted API (showcase minimal code changes).
Open/opening concerns / blockers:
- Still comparing total cost vs OpenAI and Anthropic (price + client libs).
- Per-route rate limits causing early 429s during stress tests; dev worried about running into production throttles.
- No clear champion on SkyQuill exec team — founder is a technical buyer, but product owner budget approval pending.
Suggested playbook notes:
- Run a 1-week targeted POC focused on 2 features (chat-widget + reviews summary) with token budget cap and measurable KPI: p95 latency, cost per session.
- Provide example code snippets showing identical API surface to OpenAI to reduce switching friction.
- If no usage increase in 10 days, mark as at-risk and schedule closing outreach (pricing winback + competitive price comparison).
